summary_en: This work applies an untrained deep image prior to photoacoustic tomography under limited-view and noisy acquisition. Using fast forward and adjoint operators, initialization from a fast inverse, and total-variation regularization, the method improves several image-quality measures over classical TV reconstruction on simulations and experimental data, including digital-twin-based assessment.

summary_en: The paper formulates single-snapshot active-sonar beamforming as a complex LASSO reconstruction and introduces a complex approximate message-passing solver that avoids matrix inversion and uses an Onsager correction for efficient convergence. Pool and lake experiments show narrower sidelobes, improved image resolution, and stronger suppression of reverberation and background interference than conventional beamforming.
